production_code_changes.change: Added a `source_type: str | None = None` field to `BM25Document` (same construction-convenience-default precedent as `workspace_id`/`document_id`). Added a `collection_filter: list[str] | None = None` keyword parameter to `BM25Index.search()`; when non-empty, candidates are narrowed to matching `source_type` values BEFORE the per-query `BM25Okapi` instance is built (mirrors the existing `document_ids` narrowing). Empty/`None` both mean 'no restriction', matching `VectorStoreManager._build_collection_filter()`'s existing semantic-leg contract -- deliberately NOT `document_ids`'s 'empty means zero results' contract.

`refresh_bm25_corpus()` now populates `BM25Document.source_type` from each chunk's already-normalized `metadata['source_type']`. `_retrieve_keyword_only()` gained a `collection_filter` parameter and passes it to `BM25Index.search()`. `_retrieve_hybrid()` now passes `collection_filter` to the BM25 leg's `search()` call (previously only the semantic leg received it). `retrieve()` threads `collection_filter` into `_retrieve_keyword_only()` (previously not accepted by that method at all).

production_code_changes_note: Phase 4E itself made no production changes (see the historical known_findings[0] record below). This follow-up, Phase 4E-F1, made exactly the two production changes listed above -- the smallest correct fix for the confirmed gap, with no other retrieval behavior touched.
files_modified_note: test_hybrid_retriever.py and test_hybrid_retriever_properties.py needed a one-line signature update on three locally-defined BM25Index test-double subclasses (SlowBM25, _RaisingBM25, _CountingBM25) to accept the new `collection_filter` keyword parameter -- a required, mechanical consequence of threading `collection_filter` into the BM25 leg's call site, not a behavior change to those tests. test_phase4e_workspace_rag_safety.py's former KNOWN_GAP test and its docstring were updated to assert the now-correct (filtered) behavior; the historical finding itself is preserved below and in the review markdown, not deleted.

known_findings.title: collection_filter (source-type restriction) is not enforced on the BM25 leg in hybrid mode
known_findings.description: In hybrid mode, `_retrieve_hybrid()` passes `collection_filter` to the semantic leg (`_semantic_candidates`) but not to the BM25 leg (`self._bm25_index.search(...)`). `BM25Index.search()` has no source-type parameter at all. A BM25-only lexical match of a non-selected source type can therefore enter RRF fusion and appear in the final hybrid result, even though semantic-only mode correctly enforces the same filter.
known_findings.scope_of_impact: Source-type filtering only (e.g. PDF-only vs video-only). Workspace isolation, document-id filtering, and generation-authority enforcement are unaffected -- confirmed independently enforced pre-fusion for all three retrieval modes by the passing tests in TestWorkspaceIsolation, TestDocumentFiltering, and TestGenerationAuthority.
known_findings.reproduced_by_test: tests/test_phase4e_workspace_rag_safety.py::TestSourceSelection::test_KNOWN_GAP_collection_filter_is_not_enforced_against_the_bm25_leg_in_hybrid_mode (Phase 4E finding, preserved as history -- test since renamed and updated, see fix.regression_test below)
known_findings.status_history: Phase 4E (2026-09-17): documented_not_fixed, deliberately deferred per that phase's own architecture/test/validation-only scope. Phase 4E-F1 (2026-09-17, same day, follow-up task): fixed. This record is preserved rather than deleted, per Phase 4E-F1's explicit instruction not to rewrite history.
known_findings.rationale_for_not_fixing_in_phase_4e: Fixing required a multi-file production change beyond Phase 4E's single-smallest-correct-fix allowance for that phase, and source-type filtering was judged a narrower, lower-severity property than the workspace/document/authority invariants Phase 4E was scoped to validate. Recommended as the first item for a follow-up phase -- which became Phase 4E-F1.

fix.root_cause: BM25Index.search() had no source-type parameter at all, and HybridRetriever never passed collection_filter to it in either keyword-only or hybrid mode.
fix.summary: Added BM25Document.source_type and BM25Index.search(collection_filter=...), populated from each chunk's already-normalized metadata; threaded collection_filter into both HybridRetriever._retrieve_keyword_only() (previously didn't accept it at all) and _retrieve_hybrid()'s BM25 leg call (previously only the semantic leg received it). See production_code_changes above for full detail.

invariant_traceability.statement: document_ids filtering must be correctly enforced (None/single/multiple/empty) across all search modes.
Generation-authority filtering must exclude unauthorized/stale candidates before fusion and reranking.
The reranker cannot introduce a candidate not present in its input.
The reranker cannot modify chunk_id/text/metadata identity, only relevance_score/order.
Fallback on reranker failure cannot weaken authorization (must remain within the already-authorized set).
An empty document_ids filter must return zero results (non-widening).
Citation metadata must refer to actual retrieved chunks, never LLM-generated text.
A brand-new subject/domain workspace requires zero retrieval-code changes.
A brand-new workspace requires zero retrieval-code changes.
Source-type filtering is enforced through the full pipeline.
